follow-up time: Until after cesarean scar repair surgery and subsequent pregnancies in some cases
exposure: laparoscopic repair of CSD without processing scar resection
traditional laparoscopic resection and suture of CSD
outcome: Resolution or improvement of CSD-related postmenstrual bleeding
cohort: 76 women diagnosed with CSD who had a residual myometrium thickness less than 3 mm and desired to conceive
finding: Laparoscopic repair without scar resection was effective in thickening the residual myometrium and improving postmenstrual bleeding in women with CSD.
